utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Sam — I’m hearing the repair drive may have moved to Sunday at the community center, but I’m waiting on Marta for the exact time and drop-off details before I spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’ll hold off on sharing anything until Marta confirms, since I’d heard Saturday morning and I’m supposed to cover the 10–12 intake table.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Sam — please hold the 10–12 slot loosely for now, and I’ll let you know as soon as Marta confirms whether it’s Sunday or still Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ira, it’s coming along, but my head’s a sieve—I think Saturday morning at Eli’s is right, and Marta’s the safest person to confirm the time and supply list before you tell folks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — I’d heard Saturday late morning, but I’ll check with Jules for the confirmed time and supply list before I spread anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s wise, Ira—Jules may know too, though I’d still nudge Marta or the flyer before we treat late morning as settled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Faye, I’m still catching up on the repair drive details—do you have the clearer tool list yet, and should I still plan on helping at the sign-up table?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please plan on the sign-up table, Nell—that would be a big help. The tool list is mostly tape, gloves, spare parts, and Gus’s tools so far, and I’m still confirming who’ll handle the repair list and ledger.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll plan on the sign-up table and bring the repair list Saturday at 9, unless Marta or Cleo says otherwise. I’ll also check back about the ledger once you’ve got that confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got that bag of tools set aside, Dane — pliers, wrenches, and screwdrivers. I’ll leave it labeled by the back door tomorrow morning, quiet and easy.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Uli, thank you — I’ll swing by tomorrow morning and grab the labeled bag without making a fuss. I’ll make sure everything gets back to you after the drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll tuck it just inside the back step, and I appreciate you getting them back when you can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Kira. As I understand it, we’re starting Saturday at 9 at my place, with the repair list in hand, and we’ll only change anything if Marta or Cleo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Morning, Eli — can you confirm whether 9 is just setup at your place, or the actual public window? I’ve also heard 10 to 1, and I don’t want to mark the repair list wrong.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good catch, Kira — 9 is setup at my place, not the public window. Mark the public repair drive as 10 to 1 unless Marta or Cleo tells us otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I’m happy to bring along a few tools for the repair drive—just tell me what you’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I think Mara’s pulling the tool list together, so maybe send her what you can bring and we’ll see what’s still missing once Rosa or the flyer confirms the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I’ll check in with Mara and send over what I can bring—probably the drill, socket set, and a few basics.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I’m still confirming the repair drive details, but I’m keeping track of offers and needs — have you heard what items folks want fixed first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, Rey—I’ve been holding off on guessing, but I’ve asked around who’s keeping the repair list. If you’re tracking offers and needs, I can point folks to you until we confirm the full details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — send folks my way, but maybe tell them I’m just collecting notes until the repair list is confirmed. I’ll share what I learn as soon as it’s solid.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, we’re aiming for Saturday 10 to 1. Can you tell me what still needs fixing and any supplies we’re short on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve only got leaky gutters by the community room and a few porch steps on the fix list so far, Leo; for supplies, I’m still waiting on Marta to confirm before I mark anything short.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’ll hold off on the supply list until Marta confirms; please add any new repair requests by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m happy to help with the repair drive, but I still need the confirmed drop-off location and exact time window before I tell anyone to bring items over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — the drop-off location is confirmed as the community center on Sunday, and I’m still firming up the exact time window before you spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll hold off on telling people until you have the exact Sunday window, since I don’t want anyone showing up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, any word yet on the repair drive time, location, or what needs fixing first? I’m holding off on spreading anything until you’ve got it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Not confirmed yet, Vik—I’ve only heard they may need tables, tools, and setup volunteers, but I’m still checking on the time, place, and first repairs before you spread anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Noah — I won’t spread anything yet. Once you confirm the time, place, and first repairs, I’ll pass along the needs for tables, tools, and setup volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, before anyone buys supplies, have you confirmed with Marta who’s writing the repair list and who’s keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, Mina—I’ve only got Gus’s tool list and the basics noted, so I’ll check with Marta now about the repair list and ledger before we buy anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please do it today, and tell me and Faye the two names before any money gets spent.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—I appreciate you not guessing. Once Marta, Faye, or the flyer confirms the time, could you also check whether Rosa has the written repair list and who’s officially keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Hana—I’ll wait for proper confirmation first, then I’ll ask Rosa about the written list and find out who’s officially minding the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess. I’ll hold off on committing until you’ve got those details confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, I’m still waiting on Noah to confirm the repair drive details, but once I hear the time, place, and what needs fixing, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. Please send Noah’s confirmed time, place, and fix list as soon as you get it so I can line up people and tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Leo — I won’t pass along guesses, but as soon as Noah confirms the time, place, and fix list, I’ll get it to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Noah, I’m glad I caught you—my notes are a bit scrambled, so are the final time, location, and volunteer needs settled yet, or should I still wait for you and Rosa to confirm?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—yeah, I’d still wait for confirmation from me and Rosa; I’ve only heard bits about tools, tables, and setup volunteers, and I’m still checking the written repair list and who’s keeping the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah—that helps. I’ll keep my mouth mostly shut for now and tell folks we’re waiting on you and Rosa before I repeat any time, place, or volunteer jobs as settled.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, quick version: I’m willing to help with coffee or check-in, but I’m still treating 10 Saturday in the laundromat community room as tentative until Rosa or the flyer confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds wise, Bo — I’m covering the 10–12 intake table and bringing masking tape, but I’m also waiting on the flyer or Marta/Leo before spreading exact details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, Sam — I’ll just say you’re tentatively on intake with tape, and I won’t spread the time or place as definite until Rosa, Marta, Leo, or the flyer confirms.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, I’ll wait for Rosa’s verification before I commit—just send me the confirmed repair list and the ledger keeper’s name when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Hana — I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmation and send you only the verified repair list and ledger keeper’s name when I have them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules; I’ll stay on pause until I hear those verified details from you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’m still working off second-hand updates, but I’m planning to bring the repair list Saturday at 9 and help at the sign-up table if Marta or Cleo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — Saturday at 9 helps, and I’ll treat it as tentative until Marta or Cleo confirms. If the list still has the gutters and porch steps up top, I can help steer folks there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great, Rey—if Marta or Cleo confirms the list, I’ll point folks your way for gutters and porch steps first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal — I’m a bit behind as usual, but I’m checking with Cleo on the supply list and won’t share times or drop-off details until Marta or Leo confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — I’ll mark supplies as pending with Cleo, and I won’t log any final time or drop-off details until Marta or Leo confirms.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Opal — if anyone asks, just point them to Cleo’s pending list for supplies and tell them I’m still checking who’s keeping the repair ledger.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, I’m tracking supplies for the repair drive before we buy anything—right now I’ve got tape, gloves, spare parts, maybe tools or extra wood, and Gus can lend tools. Do you know who’s writing the repair list or keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell’s bringing the repair list Saturday at 9, and I told folks not to treat changes as official unless you or Marta confirm them. I don’t have a firm ledger keeper yet—if you want to name one, I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli—that helps; please tell folks Nell’s repair list is Saturday at 9, and changes only count if Marta or I confirm them. I’ll hold off buying anything until we name a ledger keeper and see what the list actually needs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, no rush—once you hear back from the organizers, just tell me what tools are actually needed and I’ll set them aside.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—I appreciate you waiting. I’ll check in with the organizers today and send you the confirmed tool list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Mara—thanks for checking first. I’ll keep my tools free and wait for your confirmed list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep the bag labeled by the back door tomorrow morning, and Sunday details are fine whenever you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli, thank you — I’ll swing back with the exact Sunday drop-off window once it’s confirmed today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you handling it; I’ll make sure the bag’s ready and easy to spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, before anyone chips in money, do you know who’s writing the repair list and who’s keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t know yet, Mina, and I’d rather not have anyone pay in until we’ve got one named person for the repair list and one for the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, then let’s hold off on collecting money until those two names are confirmed. Can you ask Faye or Cleo to name them before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still tentative, Kira — Opal said Saturday around 10 in the community room by the laundromat, but I’m waiting on Marta or the flyer to confirm before I hand you a firm list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but let’s not treat it as set until Marta or the flyer confirms Saturday at 10. Once you’ve got that firm list, send it my way and I’ll check who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I won’t call it set yet — I’ll wait for Marta or the flyer, and once I’ve got the confirmed time and list, I’ll bring it straight to you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, quick repair drive update while I’m out: Saturday late morning is still the plan, but we’re still short on tables, a few tools, and a couple setup volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep Saturday 10 to 1 as the plan and ask the school families for tables, tools, and setup help. I’ll also check who can handle the repair list and ledger so Cleo isn’t left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll pass along that you’re checking with the school families and confirm any final details with Jules before folks spread them too widely.
